SOM.note: Refers only to unnamed existing data protection legislation and institutions; no standing, authority, regulation or application stated.
States no law in force by name, no authority appointed and no practice; only non-ratification, recorded under regionallaw.

facts.fact: Somali civil society organisations convened by SONSA state that Somalia has not ratified the Malabo Convention and urge its signature, so it has not signed.
facts.system: African Union Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection (Malabo Convention)
